tagline: Digital menu with orders on WhatsApp
shortDescription: Create your restaurant's online menu in minutes and get orders straight on WhatsApp. No commission per order, no app.
description: {name} is the platform that turns your restaurant's menu into a professional page, ready to take delivery and pickup orders. You add the business and the dishes, share the link or the QR code, and orders arrive ready on your WhatsApp — no commission per sale.

meta.homeTitle: {name} — digital menu with orders on WhatsApp
meta.ogImageText: Add your restaurant, publish the menu and get orders ready to go. No commission per sale.

footer.blurb: {tagline}. You get the order ready to go and pay no commission per sale.
footer.madeFor: Made for those who sell straight from their own menu.

hero.title: Your menu, orders on WhatsApp
hero.text: Build your menu, share the link or the QR code and get every order ready on your WhatsApp. No commission.

howItWorks.title: From sign-up to first order in three steps

capabilities.title: Your rules, applied to the menu

pricing.title: One plan, everything included
pricing.text: Selling more doesn't make the bill bigger. The price is the same in a slow month and in a month with a line out the door.

finalCta.title: Your menu live today
finalCta.strip: no commission · unlimited orders · your customers install nothing

create.label: Add
create.title: Add your menu
create.text: Name, price, photo and add-ons. You can start with just a few items.

share.label: Share
share.title: Share the link or the QR code
share.text: A short address for social media and a QR code for the table and the packaging.

receive.label: Receive
receive.title: Get the order on WhatsApp
receive.text: The message arrives ready: items, add-ons, address and notes.

addons.label: Add-ons
addons.title: Add-ons that add up
addons.text: Required groups, choice limits and paid extras. The price adds up on the spot.

delivery.label: Delivery
delivery.title: Fee and time by neighborhood
delivery.text: Each area with its own fee, minimum order and free delivery above the amount you set.

pickup.label: Pickup
pickup.title: Counter pickup
pickup.text: Turn on pickup, say how long it takes to be ready and customers choose it in the bag.

hours.label: Hours
hours.title: Open and closed at the right time
hours.text: The page follows your weekly hours and pauses orders when the kitchen closes.

menu.label: Menu
menu.title: Prices and sold-out items, instantly
menu.text: Change it in the dashboard, it changes on the published menu. Sold-out items get out of the customer's way.

promotion.label: Promotion
promotion.title: Short link and QR code
promotion.text: One address for social media and a QR code for the table, the packaging and the window.
